Name.dc.html.title: 2 · What should the sky call you?

title.text: Human Wonder · the app, before we build it

howto.text:
Press Play on any screen to use it.

Screen 3 starts the way the app does: Orbit 412 rises over the horizon, finds your signal, then greets you. Tap a suggestion or type a question and watch the answer come down from orbit.

Try the Orbit / Ground switch and the tone chip (Balanced, Poetic, Scientific, Whisper).

On this canvas Orbit 412 carries a few prepared answers; in the app it answers anything you ask.
